privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.subtitle: How we process and protect your personal data.

s1.title: Data collected
s1.text: As part of a request, we may collect your identity, contact details and information about your financing project. We never collect a PIN, CVV or banking password.

s2.title: Purposes
s2.text: Your data is used to review your request, respond to you and follow up on your file.

s3.title: Retention
s3.text: Your data is kept for as long as necessary to process your request and meet applicable legal obligations. [Specific durations to be completed].

s4.title: Your rights
s4.text: You have rights to access, correct and delete your data. [How to exercise them to be completed].

s5.title: Security
s5.text: We implement technical and organisational measures to protect your data.

privacy.disclaimer: Demonstration document. The final policy, compliant with applicable regulations, will be published before production launch.

complaints.title: Complaints
complaints.subtitle: We are committed to handling every complaint seriously and diligently.

steps.s1: Contact our team via the Contact page, specifying the subject of your complaint.
steps.s2: We acknowledge receipt of your request and register it.
steps.s3: Your complaint is reviewed by the relevant department.
steps.s4: We provide you with a reasoned response as soon as possible.

complaints.escalation: If the response provided does not satisfy you, the applicable recourse and mediation options will be specified here. [Competent authority / mediator — to be completed].
complaints.disclaimer: Demonstration procedure. Official contact details and recourse options will be specified before production launch.

q1.a: No. The "from 3%" rate is an indicative starting rate. The actual rate depends on the review of your file, your profile and prevailing conditions. It is neither automatic nor guaranteed.

q2.q: Does the simulation constitute an offer?
q2.a: No. The simulator provides an estimate for illustration only. It does not constitute an offer, a financing agreement or a contractual commitment.

q3.q: What types of financing do you offer?
q3.a: Personal loan, auto financing, renovation loan, debt consolidation, business financing and project financing.

q4.q: Is the service available in English?
q4.a: Yes. The entire site and support are available in both French and English.

q5.a: Your data is protected by technical and organisational measures. We never ask for a PIN, CVV, banking password or SMS code.

q6.q: How long does a file review take?
q6.a: Timelines depend on each file. You can track progress at any time from your client area (coming soon).
